description: Returns the status of a tfuel_swap by the status_id tfuel_swap returned: waiting, confirming, exchanging, sending, finished, failed, refunded, expired or cancelled, and the Theta payout tx once sent. Poll at most every 30 s. Read-only; needs sign-in as the wallet that made the swap.

status_id.description: The status_id returned by tfuel_swap (24 url-safe characters)

name: tfuel_swap_status
title: TFUEL swap status
